data.one_liner: PubNub SDK for Dart and Flutter to build real-time messaging applications
data.what_it_does: Connects your Dart or Flutter application to the PubNub Data Streaming Network. It allows you to publish messages, subscribe to channels using streams, and fetch channel history.
use_when: You need real-time messaging or chat features in your app
You want to stream data updates across multiple clients instantly
avoid_when: You are using a completely different backend or messaging service like Firebase
strengths: Supports multiple keysets and channel history retrieval
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml, configure your keyset with PubNub keys, and run build_runner if generating necessary source files.
